## What and why

## Regression evidence (required)
- [ ] I added or updated tests at the right level (unit / integration / e2e) for this change
- [ ] A bug fix includes a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally

## Risk
- [ ] No new secrets, no widened permissions, no new network egress
- [ ] Accessibility checked (keyboard + axe) for UI changes
- [ ] Docs / CHANGELOG updated if behaviour changed
